verdict.rationale: Qapita's own stock option page claims it helps companies 'communicate employee stock plans with clarity' [qapita-docs-8], and it positions the cap table as a source of truth for employees as well as founders and investors [qapita-docs-4]. This is only a glancing, tagline-level claim, with no detail on what employees actually see. Missing for 10: documented plain-language explanations of tax treatment for employees, explanation of exercise windows, dilution explainers, screenshots or docs of the employee-facing view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
